explanatory_strength.rationale: Business mechanics are clear from filings: $23.77B FY2025 revenue (+10.5%), $9.85B free cash flow, 95% Digital Media gross margin, and $22.52B RPO with 65% converting inside twelve months. Competitive advantage is workflow lock-in plus enterprise Experience contracts; generative-AI competition is named and mapped to an explicit reserve component rather than hand-waved.

evidence_sufficiency.rationale: Owner cash, RPO, debt, buybacks, and SBC reconcile in filing_facts with valid contract proofs (100% proof_complete_pct). Gaps remain: segment owner cash is revenue-weighted, management_facts is empty, and Firefly monetization is a wide milestone band without cohort attach disclosure.

downside_control.rationale: Cash conversion and net liquidity bound distress risk, but competitive share loss is the real path to capital impairment. Contract low $350/sh is ~49% below $234.74; AI competition reserve (−$45 to −$5/sh) and Firefly ($0–$120/sh) show how fast the story can re-rate if seats stall. Partial dhando, not a floor at book.

return_vs_alternatives.rationale: Contract base annualized return at $234.74 is 15.81% (low 5.87%, high 22.93%) versus Lawrence synthesis 32.04%. Mechanics support a mid-teens cash compounder, not a unique 30%+ opportunity versus other pricing-power software names once AI competition is reserved.

claims.claim: FY2025 free cash flow was $9.85B ($23.07 per diluted share) on $23.77B revenue, with Digital Media gross margin 95% and RPO $22.52B (65% within twelve months).
Universal contract base value is $656/sh at spot $234.74, implying 15.81% annualized return over seven years after five additive components with valid calculation proofs.
H1 FY2026 revenue was $13.02B (+12.3% YoY), so near-term top-line momentum is intact while the AI competitive falsifier remains forward-looking rather than already realized in filings.

strongest_counter_explanation: Seat and ARPU growth plus Firefly attach are already embedded in RPO and H1 acceleration; the market is correctly pricing a durable creative-workflow standard, and the AI reserve overstates near-term churn, making contract multiples too conservative versus Lawrence-style growth.
most_important_missing_fact: Digital Media net new seats and generative-AI credit attach by cohort (individual versus enterprise) to test whether competitive advantage is stable or already eroding in the mix.
falsifiers: Two consecutive quarters where RPO growth lags revenue growth
Trailing four-quarter free cash flow per share below $18.00 for four quarters
Documented sustained decline in Digital Media net new ARR alongside rising competitive seat wins by Canva/Figma-class tools
specialist_findings: Hohn lens: cash conversion and operating leverage are excellent; competitive advantage is real but contested. Audit of economic claims: overlap keys clean; AI competition and SBC reserve is the correct place to park competitive risk; Firefly remains optionality with a wide band. Do not size on Lawrence 32% synthesis while contract capitalization clears the hurdle only marginally at 15.81%. Watch until seat-cohort and AI attach mechanics are filing- or management-verified.
